summary: enGene Therapeutics disclosed a workforce reduction of ~50%, effective June 14, 2026, to preserve cash while awaiting FDA durability data for its LEGEND cohort. The board approved the restructuring, with estimated cash costs of $5.7-6.4M (severance, benefits) and $4.7-5.0M non-cash stock-based compensation. The company retains resources for key milestones, including Cohort 1 completion, enrolling a surfactant cohort, FDA meetings, and BLA initiation in H2 2026. The filing includes Item 2.02 results and Item 8.01 update. Watch for regulatory feedback on detalimogene and potential delays in BLA submission timeline.
